close_reason: Implemented extract::extract_aia_http_urls returning AiaUrls{ocsp, ca_issuers}. id-ad-ocsp and id-ad-caIssuers AccessDescription entries with http://https:// URI accessLocations are partitioned. Other accessMethods and non-HTTP schemes silently dropped. Tests cover: extension absent, both buckets populated, ldap OCSP filtered while https OCSP kept, malformed DER. Oracle is openssl x509 -text -noout. Same commit bb825493 as PKIX-a1yc.2 (shared module).
description:
## Why

pkix-revocation-http needs to extract:
- OCSP responder URLs (id-ad-ocsp = 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1)
- CA issuer URLs (id-ad-caIssuers = 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2) — for fetching missing intermediates

from a Certificate's authorityInfoAccess extension (OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1). No public helper exists in the workspace; only an OID constant in pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:126.

## What

Public helper(s) in the same `extract` module as PKIX-a1yc.2:

```rust
pub struct AiaUrls {
    pub ocsp: Vec<String>,
    pub ca_issuers: Vec<String>,
}

pub fn extract_aia_http_urls(cert: &x509_cert::Certificate)
    -> Result<AiaUrls, ExtractError>;
```

Walk extensions for OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1; DER-decode `AuthorityInfoAccessSyntax` (a SEQUENCE OF AccessDescription); for each AccessDescription:

- accessMethod `1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1` (id-ad-ocsp) + accessLocation `uniformResourceIdentifier` → push to `ocsp` (filtered to http/https).
- accessMethod `1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2` (id-ad-caIssuers) + accessLocation `uniformResourceIdentifier` → push to `ca_issuers` (filtered to http/https).
- Anything else → ignore (caller can extend later; e.g., id-ad-timestamping is not relevant here).

Type the OIDs as `const ObjectIdentifier` in the module so they're discoverable.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Helper extracts OCSP and caIssuers HTTP URLs separately.
- [ ] http:// and https:// only — other schemes (e.g. directoryName-shaped accessLocation, ldap://) filtered out.
- [ ] Returns AiaUrls with empty Vecs when extension absent or no http URLs present.
- [ ] Returns Err on malformed DER.
- [ ] Unit tests with hand-rolled Certificate fixtures covering: extension absent, only OCSP URL, only caIssuers URL, both, malformed DER.
- [ ] Oracle: openssl text output of fixture certs matches helper output.

## Out of scope

- caIssuers fetching itself (a separate path-builder concern, not v0.x of pkix-revocation-http).
- Other accessMethod OIDs (id-ad-timestamping, etc.).

## Effort

~80 lines + tests + 2-3 fixture certs.
title: AIA URL extraction helper (OCSP responder + caIssuers)
